title: JP-TL-Bench: Anchored Pairwise LLM Evaluation for Bidirectional Japanese-English Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting bilingual human reviewer spot-checks on a subset of items to verify whether the LLM judge's high ranking of its own model family's outputs reflects genuine translation quality or a biased self-preference.
Mitigated and accounted for in the evaluation protocol by randomizing which candidate model is presented as 'Translation A' versus 'Translation B' for each pairwise LLM judgment.
